issues.title: Regression: the new round wing rolls are too fat and stand level with or proud of the cover, so they hide its aisle edge (q17 cover 57 % of the photo's area, was 72 %); in y_47306 / y_47303 the flap lies in front of the rolls
issues.evidence: cov.py, same mask: candidate 3980 px, x633-733 y161-250; before 4992, x639-754 y147-247; photo 6961, x663-789 y177-299. In head17.png the near cover's lower aisle corner is cut diagonally by the wing roll. Geometry in 58aca6d, as front z = z - d/2. Wing at y 0.69: -0.0875 - 0.0675 = -0.155; at 0.77: -0.085 - 0.065 = -0.150; at 0.802: -0.072 - 0.0525 = -0.1245. Cover: 0.70 -> -0.158, 0.78 -> -0.144, 0.806 -> -0.1245. So the cover is only 0.3 cm proud at mid-height and 0.6 cm BEHIND the wing at y 0.77-0.78. y_47306 (p47306.png) shows narrow sausage rolls (~5 cm visible) whose inner halves sit behind the flap's side edges. The w45 note in the code records the same problem ('the wings hid the q17 cover: y_47303 shows the flap in front of them').
issues.fix: In econSeat (09a_econ.js, the wing-roll loftAt at sx +-0.163), keep the round section but make it smaller and set it back, so its front is >= 1.5 cm behind the cover at every height. Suggested sections: SEC(0.585, 0.045, 0.06, -0.045, 0.022, sx), SEC(0.605, 0.06, 0.095, -0.07, 0.03, sx), SEC(0.69, 0.064, 0.11, -0.077, 0.032, sx), SEC(0.77, 0.062, 0.105, -0.072, 0.031, sx), SEC(0.802, 0.054, 0.085, -0.06, 0.027, sx), SEC(0.817, 0.04, 0.05, -0.045, 0.02, sx). Optionally move sx to +-0.158 so the flap (half width 0.111) overlaps the rolls' inner ~1 cm, as in y_47306. Leave the CPL drape as it is: it fixed q15.
